# Client.delete_profile_photos

**Section:** Account · [Client index](../client.md)

Delete explicit native account photo references using their actual hashes.

## Signature

```python
async def delete_profile_photos(photos: Sequence[types.Photo | types.InputPhoto]) -> list[int]
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Python type | Default | Passing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `photos` | `Sequence[types.Photo \| types.InputPhoto]` | `Required` | Positional or keyword |

### photos

Sequence of 1–100 native Photo/InputPhoto values with real server IDs, access hashes and file references. Integer IDs alone are not sufficient.

## Returns

list[int] returned by Telegram.

## Behavior and constraints

- Accepts 1–100 Photo/InputPhoto values from real metadata. Integer IDs alone cannot manufacture required access/file references.
- Requires a connected authorized account unless only a known identity is handled locally. Server RPC errors, deadlines and cancellation propagate; ambiguous writes are not automatically retried.
